name: html-inline-svg-native-image-passive
description: Routes passive self-contained inline SVG artwork to native core/image using a data:image/svg+xml source, preserving gradients, alt text, and intrinsic viewBox sizing without core/html fallback.

source_reference.notes: Distilled structural shape for labelled illustration/logo SVGs with explicit colors and defs. It avoids fixture-specific class names.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
